from datetime import datetime, date
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year
start=f"{year}-02-01"
end_today=date(year,now.month,now.day).isoformat()
print('year',year,'start',start,'end_today',end_today)

venmo_token=access['access_token']
coworker_emails=set(e.lower() for e in coworker_emails)

total=0.0
matched=[]
page=0
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='received', min_created_at=start, max_created_at=end_today, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    print('page',page,'count',len(resp))
    for t in resp:
        sender_email=(t.get('sender',{}) or {}).get('email','').strip().lower()
        if sender_email in coworker_emails:
            amt=t.get('amount',0.0)
            total += float(amt)
            matched.append((t.get('transaction_id'), amt, t.get('created_at'), (t.get('sender',{}) or {}).get('name'), sender_email, t.get('description')))
    page += 1

print('total',total)
print('matched',len(matched))
print('matched sample',matched[:5])
